paragraphs: TeamDynamix sells a no-code platform for IT and enterprise service management and project portfolio management, with automation and integration included. The company describes one platform that also carries IT asset management, conversational AI support agents and iPaaS integration.

Teams automate work from password resets to onboarding and offboarding through a visual flow builder instead of code. An assistant for technicians suggests field values, resolutions, related tickets and knowledge base content. Its conversational agents run through connectors for web chat, SMS, Slack, Microsoft Teams and social media. Service management extends past IT to HR, facilities, finance, legal and marketing.

The company says it serves organizations across more than 20 industries, among them higher education and state, local and federal government. Its case studies include Pima County deploying no-code workflow automation. Another describes the City of Lake Oswego expanding to full enterprise service management without adding resources. TeamDynamix gives its founding as 2001 in Columbus, Ohio. It describes itself as a K1 Investment Management portfolio company with Rod Mathews as chief executive. Its asset management capability followed the acquisition of Sassafras Software in April 2025.

quote.text: TeamDynamix offers a no-code platform for ITSM/ESM and PPM with enterprise automation and integration.
